blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Davao City Mayor Sebastian Duterte can testify before the Senate Impeachment Court if the local government had dealt with companies where his sister, Vice President Sara Duterte, is listed as a stockholder, a member of the prosecution panel said on Wednesday. In a press briefing after the Wednesday’s impeachment discussions, counsel for the prosecution Benjamin Tolosa Jr. said they want to know if the city government had entered into contracts with Davao-based Gencorp Industries Inc. — a company listed in Vice President Duterte’s Statements of Assets, Liabilities and Net Worth (SALN) as a company that she has stock shares […]...
